## Change type

- [ ] Application code
- [ ] Lesson content
- [ ] Printable resource
- [ ] Schedule
- [ ] Schema or governance

## Content checks

- [ ] No theological claim was added or changed without evidence classification.
- [ ] Required reviewers are assigned.
- [ ] Safeguarding and accessibility fields were reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] No sensitive child information is included.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run validate:content`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] Netlify Deploy Preview reviewed
